name: cast admission planner (plan_resolved_cast_core)
semantic_facts: hard errors via ? in order: target policy, caster index, cost hard errors, cooldown schedule error, root-program quote (target support, health preflight), start-recovery schedule, operation dead target
timed blockers folded by dominant_timed_blocker (latest recheck wins, non-timed wins): cost, start recovery, cast in progress, school lock, prevention (stun short-circuits silence/pacify)
HardCompletion mode skips cast-in-progress, school lock, stun/silence/pacify and start recovery; cooldown skipped only for attr-407 acceptance-owned cooldowns
no caster-life gate (CSA-G-01)
validate_cast_progress runs last (NonProgressing)

name: hard-cast lifecycle (CastAuthority + begin/complete)
semantic_facts: acceptance commits acceptance-owned cooldown, start recovery, then pending cast with prepared costs (no resource spend)
completion re-plans against current state with prepared costs; failure -> finish_cast + CastCompleted Failed, nothing else mutated
one pending cast per actor; generation u64 per actor; next completion = min(completes_at, actor index)
cancel is generation-checked; reset zeroes cells/generations/prepared costs/school locks

name: start recovery (GCD) authority
semantic_facts: per actor x category ready_at; quote blocks when now < ready_at; start overwrites ready_at = now + effective_duration(haste at start)
duration = base/speed truncated to ms, at least 1 ms, then max(minimum)
not restored on interruption (CSA-G-02)

name: cast cooldown quote/commit wrappers
semantic_facts: quote folds deadline + charge readiness into Blocked/Ready; commit recomputes deadline-start input from the same state (cooldowns committed first in commit_cast so inputs are unchanged)
completion-owned by default; attr-407 (Dark Bite 394463) cooldown committed at acceptance and never re-quoted at completion; retained on cancel/failure (matches Trinity Spell.cpp:3569-3570, 5790)

name: raw-68 interrupt compiler + runtime
semantic_facts: exact carrier 159006:1, sole operation, 6000 ms lockout; any hard cast with SpellInterrupts row rejects the whole program
interrupts only a pending cast whose prevention mask contains Silence; installs lockout for each school bit of interrupted action school
dead target -> progressing no-op (CSA-G-04)

name: school lock authority
semantic_facts: per actor x 7 school deadlines; commit overwrites deadline for each bit
admission blocks Silence-prevention actions whose school intersects an active lock unless IgnoreSchoolLockout (exact 117833)
not consulted at completion

name: Stun compiler + StunView
semantic_facts: exact carrier 346197:1 100 ms; raw-163 exemption exact Full Heal 25840 (1 s hard cast, empty prevention)
fresh cancel only on the actor's transition from not-stunned to stunned; cancels regardless of allows_while_stunned (matches Trinity SetControlled/CastStop)

name: Silence compiler + SilenceView
semantic_facts: exact carriers 118370:2 (4 s) and 326836:1 (5 s, itself a 3 s hard cast); school from misc_0 (127 in source)
admission intersects school; fresh application cancels any Silence-prevention pending cast regardless of school (matches Trinity)

name: Pacify compiler + PacifyView
semantic_facts: exact carrier 10730:1 4000 ms via ExactActionPreventionCarrier
fresh application cancels Pacify-prevention pending cast

name: Pacify+Silence compiler
semantic_facts: exact carrier 32913:1 5000 ms enabling both pacify and silence bits on one application; runtime candidate order stun, pacify, silence (find_map first match)

name: action prevention carrier audit + runtime view
semantic_facts: carrier owners are sole-effect, instant, primary-target, no costs/cooldowns, sole application -> at most one fresh prevention quote per segment
quote uses committed AuraState/CastAuthority; commit cancels generation-checked and emits CastStunned/CastSilenced/CastPacified only if impact landed

name: active casting speed (raw 65 / raw 216)
semantic_facts: changes actor haste multipliers at aura commit; accepted hard casts are not rescheduled (deadline captured at acceptance); passive resource flows settled before and rebased after

name: fixed travel time + missile timing gate
semantic_facts: exact 373932:1, 1.5 s hard cast, 1 s delay; every compiled program (roots and children) with nonzero missile facts rejects unless it is the exact fixed plan root
fixed impact lands only if target life equals life at launch

name: chain delivery gate
semantic_facts: any non-neutral effect chain facts reject (single-recipient delivery only)

name: power cost compiler + prepared cast costs
semantic_facts: costs prepared at quote/acceptance (required + min(optional, remaining)), snapshotted into CastAuthority at acceptance, re-quoted with the snapshot and committed at completion
insufficient prepared cost at completion -> Failed without recheck

name: additional power cost modifier
semantic_facts: aura subtype ModAdditionalPowerCost contributes optional-points adjustment to prepared cost; evaluated at preparation time only

name: mana cost percent modifier
semantic_facts: aura subtype ModManaCostPercent contributes mana_percent points to prepared cost at preparation time

name: school power cost percent modifier
semantic_facts: exact carrier 23553:1 -15% Shadow mana cost; prepared at preparation time

name: target requirements + health preflight
semantic_facts: caster life required only when an operation writes caster health; target life only when an operation writes target health; interrupt requires neither (CSA-G-01, CSA-G-04)

name: source recipient validation
semantic_facts: implicit targets (1|25|6|21, 0) map to Caster/Target with disposition Hostile for 6 and Friendly for 21; (0,0) admits no disposition; anything else rejects

name: combat transition ordering
semantic_facts: same-time order: resource-threshold startup(0) < passive-flow threshold(1) < cast completion(2, by actor index) < fixed impact(3) < white main hand(4) < periodic(5) < aura/stack expiry(6)
external API casts at time t run after advance processed all transitions at t (completion wins over a same-time interrupt through the public API)

name: acceptance-owned cooldown (Dark Bite) carrier
semantic_facts: exact 394463 attr 407: shared category 1152 3 s cooldown committed at acceptance; resets white main hand after successful hard completion only
